description: This file exports constants related to a diagram with ID 690 and defines a module for rendering flowchart diagrams using a set of internal functions and external dependencies. It includes functions for creating SVG/HTML elements, drawing nodes and edges, and configuring styles and layout, specifically tailored to flowchart visualization.

methods.name: l
methods.description: Creates a foreignObject with embedded HTML element (div) reflecting a label, used for diagram nodes.

methods.name: o
methods.description: Checks if an element has children with a specific class.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a label's properties for debugging or display.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Applies style attributes to a DOM element.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Sets CSS classes on an element, possibly appending extra class names.

methods.name: p
methods.description: Transitions a diagram element based on its associated graph transitions.
